evidence.reason: At the pinned tip `_timer_schedule_seconds` still computes the overall completion bound as `max(intervals) + accuracy` and never reads or accounts for `RandomizedDelaySec`. systemd applies `RandomizedDelaySec=` as an additional delay on each timer activation, so a timer declaring it can activate later than the returned bound while the helper reports a too-short deadline. This is a routine correctness defect in the existing bound calculation; the smallest compatible fix is to parse and add the randomized delay to the overall and repeat bounds (or reject such timer templates if intentionally unsupported).
